## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass with `npm test`.
- [ ] Production build passes with `npm run build`.
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage.
- [ ] UI changes were checked at desktop and mobile widths.
- [ ] User-facing strings are available in English and French.
- [ ] No secret, token, private conversation, or infrastructure-specific value is included.

## Hermes compatibility

List the Hermes contracts used or changed. Mention the tested Hermes version and any fallback behavior.
